02 / ABOUT
Behind The Cuts

Editing sirf clips jodna nahi hai — ye timing, rhythm aur emotion ka game hai. Har frame ka reason hona chahiye.

Reels ho, YouTube ka long-form content ho, ya kisi ki wedding ki sabse special day — main har project ko uske audience ke hisaab se edit karta hoon. Fast cuts jab energy chahiye, aur slow, cinematic pacing jab emotion sabse zaroori ho.
